item: truths-first (LPT) dispatch order in two-phase services pipeline
workload: prefix4 Ethereum (4 CPU proofs + 3 truth proofs), /tmp/stwo-rv64-ethereum-round5-native-jobs-v1
machine_note: Apple Silicon, 2 lanes x 8 workers; machine may be shared with other user jobs; each run serialized via lockf on /private/tmp/stwo-rv64-perf-heavy.lock
sequence: ABBA (A = baseline 87df8e6a5 driver, B = branch driver)
byte_identity: all *.bin, bundle.json, cells.bin of all four runs match /private/tmp/stwo-rv64-perf-runs/baseline-prefix4.sha256 (10/10 OK each)

stage_sums_s.note: sum over the 7 physical-*.stages.json of all top-level stage seconds; ordering does not target any single per-proof stage, so this is a per-proof work check, not the targeted metric (the target is pipeline makespan = prove_ns)

noise: A1 vs A2 wall differ by 3.8% (below the 5% flag threshold); A1 vs A2 prove differ by 3.8%
conclusion: No gain on prefix4. Branch is ~0.87 s wall / ~0.69 s prove slower on average (both B runs above both A runs, but the gap is comparable to the A1-A2 spread, so treat as no-gain-to-slight-regression). Peak footprint +0.46 GB, consistent with truth MAIN being retained earlier in stage one. Proof bytes identical. Prefix4 contains only 3 short truth proofs (~1 s each), so it cannot exercise the full-block stage-two tail (Keccak ~20 s, ~19 s, secp-add ~13.7 s, secp-double ~6 s) this change targets; a full-block A/B is required before claiming the expected 5-8 s.
